pairs.rationale: The signature line communicates document signing, while the existing icon communicates a downward file transfer.
The signature stroke gives this icon a signing purpose that is distinct from a generic text document.
The shield communicates file protection and remains semantically distinct from the existing magnifying-glass search icon.
